notes.title: Update (Ver. 1.03.05)
notes.content:
Happy quiz time! 👻

It's been a while.
We have made an update to fix various issues and add new features.

We added a cute icon to record Rita's replies.
　No need to take notes locally anymore!
We have improved some of the presentation and graphics to make them easier to understand.
Chinese, Korean, and Spanish are now supported.

This will be the final update if there are no problems.
Enjoy your good quiz journey!
